main_turf.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise (left-handed). One of Victoria's premier regional galloping venues featuring a 450m home straight. The track layout gives every runner a fair chance on Good ground.
main_turf.post_bias: Fair across middle distances. Inside stalls 1–4 are beneficial in 1000m and 1200m sprints.

polytrack.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise (left-handed). All-weather synthetic track inside the turf course with a 400m home straight.
polytrack.post_bias: Inside stalls 1–4 hold a clear advantage in sprints to prevent being trapped 3-wide on sweeping bends.

handicapping_angles.ballarat_cup_carnival: During the Ballarat Cup ($500k) meeting in November, track class elevates to Metro/Group grade (+4.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.melbourne_metro_shippers: Top Melbourne yards (Maher, Price/Kent, Hayes, Moody/Coleman) send high-grade runners to Ballarat for maidens and benchmark handicaps.
